assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The appeal is for episode ep-05110
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis codes R55 and Z86.73 are documented
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
The payer letter states advance approval is required to ensure medical necessity
The payer letter states the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time
